unit.why: A single narrative: R. Zusha, while wandering, meets the boy Seer of Lublin, who weeps during the prayer; Zusha says he has given him nefesh and ruach and sends him to his brother R. Elimelekh.

stories.start_quote: בעת שהי׳ הרה"ק ר״ר זושא זצ"ל נע ונד
stories.end_quote: ומאז נעשה תלמיד הה״ק רבי ר' אלימלך ז"ל
stories.summary_en: During his anonymous wanderings R. Zusha prays behind the stove in the town of the ten-year-old future Seer of Lublin; his glance makes the boy weep until he weeps blood, after which Zusha says he has given him nefesh and ruach and sends him to his brother Elimelekh for neshamah, and the boy becomes Elimelekh's disciple.
